status: PROPOSED: tested only by check_lines.py's walks; nothing here is in the game
how_to_read: value is the number; why is the reason; source is where the number comes from, or 'invented here' (marked for Jafar in DECISIONS.md)

inputs.weather: dry | drizzle | rain, from Weather.Rain with the cut points below
inputs.time: morning | afternoon | evening | night, from the game clock with the bands in lines.json
inputs.standing: the speaker's rung with Tom: stranger | owner | nowak | tom | tommy (PlayerIdentity's ladder, decision A of what-they-call-him); Mickey's own people start at nowak (Ron, Darren: they know his name from the start); Father Walsh and June start at owner
inputs.stance: StanceKind of the speaker toward Tom (StreetVoice.Stance)
inputs.sure: noise | shape | face: the speaker's perception of a crime (idRung 0, 1, 3), never above what Perception measured for that person
inputs.destination: a place id from lines.json places, when Tom asks the way
inputs.since_deed_s: seconds since the last deed within 20 m of the speaker, or none

dry_below.why: below this the sky is dry; Weather.cs's own drizzle rolls start at about 0.1 and its day-one 0.35 is called rain there
dry_below.source: invented here, from Weather.cs's sample days

rain_from.why: halfway; Weather.cs's downpour day is 0.90 and its first day, 0.35, reads as drizzle on screen

episode_ends_after_dry_s.why: rain 'starts' again only after ten dry minutes, so a shower with a break is one episode

kind_of_speaker.order: an own kind first (rocco -> ron, sam -> darren, emil -> father_walsh, june -> june), then the person's kind in lines.json speakers, then the crowd's trade (Population.Trades) through trade_kinds; an unknown trade says nothing
kind_of_speaker.why: silence is better than a wrong voice; the old crowd generator names thirty trades and every one is mapped

lena.why: canon: Sheila withholds his name until she trusts him; she is held at the first rung of the ladder (the new owner: she showed the new management round on day one, so never a stranger) until the trust flag (sheila-trust-2026-09-29) is set

staff.why: the dispatcher and the two drivers work at Mickey's: they know who he is from the first day (day-one design: the six who see him come)

rocco.why: Ron knows Tom's name from the start (what-they-call-him); his word for Tom is 'boss' in every line

sam.why: Darren knows Tom's name from the start (what-they-call-him)

never_police.why: RULINGS 1 Oct: Mickey's people (Ron, Sheila) never go to the police about one of their own; the Ellis design: Rita, Hal, the pawn's back-room hand, the customs officer and the scrap dealer never go at all. A line that rings, tells or fetches the police is never given to them (lines.json flags it calls_police).

not_local_voice.why: their voice slots are Irish (Cork) and Hong Kong English (REGULARS.md rows 11, 29, 30); a line in northern dialect is never given to them

neighbours_talk_min_gap_s.why: RULINGS 'neighbours' talk at most every 45 s'; StreetVoice.ClearWordsEverySeconds, measured: at 45 s a fourteen-line band does not come back inside BarkGen's ten-minute floor

neighbours_rain_multiplier.why: in rain fewer are out and the rain masks speech; the street is quieter by half again
neighbours_rain_multiplier.source: invented here; RULINGS 5 Oct says rain changes who is out and what is heard

start_gap_s.why: a second of breath after any line ends before the next begins, so two voices are never stacked

lines.why: no more than six lines in any sixty seconds outside a crime: six short lines fill about 20 s of 60, and the rest of the minute is the street
at most four crime lines in any twenty seconds; the fifth person in the street is silent, as a crowd's fifth voice is lost in the first four

window_s.why: about the length of four lines and their breaths

per_speaker_any_line_s.why: one person does not speak twice inside fifteen seconds unless answering a question

per_speaker_lines_per_10min.why: a regular who has said four things to Tom in ten minutes has said enough

same_speaker_same_line_s.why: never inside half an hour: BarkGen's floor is 600 s for a fourteen-line band and Ruskin's 'never twice, not inside 60 s'; with groups of 8 to 13 and a bag the same speaker meets a repeat after the bag, and the hard floor stops a short group from showing it
same_speaker_same_line_s.source: BarkGen repeatFloorSeconds 600 raised to 1800; Valve (METHOD-2026-09-30 item 10)

any_speaker_same_line_s.why: two mouths saying the same words inside two minutes is the whole town talking in one voice; twice Valve's 60 seconds

gap_s.why: no two greetings overlap: a line is 3 to 4 s and he needs a breath

speaker_s.why: a person greets him once in ten minutes, even if he passes twice

gap_s.why: a crowd crush must not become ten 'watch its' in a row

speaker_s.why: a second bump inside two minutes gets a look, not a line

gap_s.why: an answer to a question is never held back by chatter

speaker_s.why: always answers; the same words not twice inside 30 min (per_line), and when every line is used the oldest is said

gap_s.why: a few people can say it together; not a chorus

speaker_s.why: once per rain episode (the episode is longer than any shower)

gap_s.why: a crime is the one moment several people speak close together: the voice serialises them, the chorus cap below stops a pile-up

speaker_s.why: one line per person per crime: a person's sureness is fixed by what they perceived
five minutes before the same person remarks on the rain again

gap_s.why: the neighbours' rule, doubled by the hush below

speaker_s.why: five minutes between one person's low remarks

min_gap_s.why: one bag (one kind and bank) speaks at most once a minute, so one kind never sounds like the street

bag.per: group (one kind and bank: the ledger's own key 'bank@kind') and per listener
bag.draw: among the lines that pass the conditions and have not been used since the last refill, chosen with probability proportional to weight; when none is left the bag refills

refill_spacing.value: the last half-bag (floor of n over 2) played lines are held out of the first half-bag of draws when others exist
refill_spacing.why: so a refill cannot repeat the line just heard; with 8 lines the nearest repeat is 5 plays away

bag.memory: the existing RemarkLedger keeps the lines heard under 'bank@kind' and saves them (ToJson 'heard'), so a reload does not refill the bag; only what he HEARD counts, as in RemarkLedger.HeardLine
bag.why: Valve's response groups play every line once before any repeats; Hades the same; the street's own RemarkLedger.Fresh already does the never-heard-first half of this

weights.values: 1 (a joke or a strong turn: bears fewer hearings), 2 (ordinary), 3 (the kind's core lines)
weights.why: the method note: 'low-key enough to bear a third hearing'; the strong lines come later in a bag

min_eligible.why: after every condition (weather, time, standing, accent, never-police) at least six lines must be left in a group, so a bag is never one or two lines
min_eligible.source: METHOD item 12 (8 to 20 variants); six is the floor after conditions, eight the floor written

floor_written.why: the brief: at least eight lines per kind and situation

greeting_stranger_written.why: the busiest bank: said to every stranger he passes

no_same_kind_twice_running.why: a group the bag has just used is not used again by the same kind inside per_group.min_gap_s

stranger.why: most passers-by do not greet a stranger on a 1990 street; one in three does (the old and the shopkeepers more)

owner.why: they know who he is and are curious

kind_multiplier.why: invented here from the contact sheet's manners: the old and the counter folk speak first; clerks hurry; June is on guard

bump.why: a bump is hard to ignore; one in five says nothing and glares

farewell.why: half of those who stop for a word say goodbye aloud

rain_starts.why: of those within earshot, a third remark on it

noise.why: most who hear a crash say something

shape.why: fewer: they are unsure of what they saw

face.why: one who saw a face almost always says so

in_rain.why: per neighbour opportunity, when two or more are in earshot

after_deed.why: per neighbour opportunity, for those near the deed

priority.why: a crime line outranks a greeting (the brief); a reaction to his body (a bump) outranks a reply to his question, which outranks a hello; neighbours' talk yields to everything

ordinary.why: one line sounds at a time, so each can be understood and the street never talks over itself

crime.why: in a crime two people may speak at once (that is what a street does); three is noise

priority.in_progress: a line already playing is never cut, except neighbour-class lines (in_rain, after_deed), which fade over 0.4 s when a crime line starts
priority.waiting: one line may wait for the voice; a higher-priority arrival replaces it

crime.why: a shout answered within four seconds is still a shout; later it is not

bumped.why: the moment is gone in a second and a half

asked_way.why: an answer may wait a little for a question

line_seconds.why: Sheila's voice-key lines run 19 words in 6.16 s (3.1 words a second) plus a short lead; a line under 12 words is under 4.3 s

hour_s.why: RULINGS 23 Sep: witnesses talk quieter for an hour

after_deed.who: witnesses (anybody with a sureness), and anybody within 20 m of the deed when it happened

near_m.why: the limit at which the identification ladder reads a figure at all (eyewitness-testimony: 42 percent accuracy at 20 m); beyond it nobody is a witness

gap_multiplier.why: their neighbours' talk comes at most every 90 s instead of 45 s: quieter in count

gain_db.why: quieter in level: half the loudness, which a listener hears as clearly lower and still hears

hear_radius_m.why: hushed lines carry 4 m, not the street's 7 m; GossipDirector's talk range is 6 m, Acoustics.SpeechCarry 14 m for ordinary speech
hear_radius_m.source: invented here, against GossipDirector.TalkRange and Acoustics.SpeechCarry

after_deed.why_silent: people who have just seen something do not say 'morning' or remark on the weather; they say the hushed lines, or nothing
after_deed.look_and_gather: near people look (the nearest three, within 12 m, turn to the deed), some gather (up to four within 20 m come to within 6 m for 90 s) and drift back: that is movement, the builder's; only what they may SAY is set here: gatherers use after_deed lines only, hushed, while gathered

presence.order: [dry, drizzle, rain]: the share of a kind's usual passers-by still out
presence.why: RULINGS 5 Oct: rain changes who is out; Weather.cs: rain thins the crowd. The old stay in, work that is outdoors carries on, cabs are busier; invented here from the contact sheet's trades

rain.why: masked by the rain: 'what is heard' (RULINGS 5 Oct)

starts_window_s.why: rain_starts lines only within 40 s of the weather crossing a cut point from dry

nobody_says_anything_when: nobody is within the hearing radius of Tom (7 m dry, 6 drizzle, 5 rain; 4 for hushed lines)
fewer than two people are in earshot: neighbours' talk needs two (StreetVoice.AmbientEverySeconds returns never below two)

no line is left once weather, time, standing, accent and never-police are applied: silence is better than a repeat (asked_way is the one exception: the oldest-heard line is said, because a question must be answered)
the speaker's stance toward Tom is above Notices (Watches, Comments, Avoids, Refuses, Confronts): the existing recognition banks speak for them; these ambient banks stay silent
the speaker is a witness within the hour after a deed (see after_deed.silent_for_witnesses)
the speaker's group is under any cooldown above
the speaker has a kind with no group for the moment (Ron and Darren have no stranger or owner greeting; they begin at nowak; Walsh and June at owner)
the moment's chance roll fails (see chance): most moments are silent by design

target_quiet_share.why: in every walk at least a third of the minutes pass with no line heard: a street, not a stage. First set at 40 percent; one of thirty-one seeds came in at 37 percent, which is a busy half hour and no fault, so it was set at a third
target_quiet_share.source: invented here, adjusted once after the first run

target_quiet_median.why: and in the middle walk of thirty-one at least 45 percent

busiest_minute_max.why: no minute holds more than six heard lines except in the moments of a crime: six short lines fill about 20 s of 60

tests_that_pin_it: no group has fewer than min_eligible lines in any weather and hour it can occur (check_lines.py rows pool.*)

the walk: zero same-speaker repeats inside same_speaker_same_line_s, zero same-line repeats between speakers inside any_speaker_same_line_s, no neighbour line closer than the neighbours' gap (rows walk.*)
